Cites GW.TACHYON v9 and v10 deposits. The satirical-bureaucratic framing (Underwater Construction Authority of Dolphindiana) is engaged on the project's own terms rather than dismissed or pathologized. Full-project recognition with the project's vocabulary largely intact.
